# Portal home lower cards use glass card and light-in-place hover

Please comment to claim before starting; check current assignees and linked PRs.

## Context

On `#/home` (`Portal.view.home.MainContainer`), the three cards in **Who Neo.mjs Is For** (`Portal.view.home.parts.AudienceDoors`) use `.portal-glass-card` (`#21651` / PR `#21674`): frosted glass (`backdrop-filter: blur(12px)`), a diagonal glint across the glass (`portal-glass-card-glint`), and a single-lap conic light sweep around the border (`portal-glass-card-sweep`) on hover and keyboard focus, with zero positional movement.

Scrolling further down the same Home page, the twelve cards in **Features** (`Portal.view.home.parts.Features`, 6 Engine subsystem cards) and **The Agent OS Brain** (`Portal.view.home.parts.AiToolchain`, 6 Brain cards) still use `.portal-content-box` (`resources/css/src/apps/portal/Viewport.css:93-152`) — rendering an opaque surface with the deprecated `transform: translateY(-4px)` hover lift and `transform: scale(0.99)` active scale.

## The Problem

Two incompatible card surfaces and hover metaphors coexist on one landing page:

1. **Deprecated lift-up motion on lower Home cards:** Hovering any of the 6 `Features` cards (`Threading Subsystem` … `Zero-Build System`) or 6 `AiToolchain` cards (`Neural Link` … `The Cross-Family Institution`) shifts the card upward by `4px` (`transform: translateY(-4px)`) and scales it on press (`transform: scale(0.99)`), moving clickable targets under the pointer and clashing with the stationary light-in-place `.portal-glass-card` doors above.
2. **Duplicate card-chrome rules in `Viewport.css`:** `.portal-content-box` (`Viewport.css:93-152`) retains pre-glass v6 card chrome (`background-color: var(--sem-color-bg-neutral-default)`, `border: 1px solid var(--sem-color-border-subtle)`, `border-radius: 12px`, `box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05)`) parallel to `.portal-glass-card` (`Viewport.css:154-266`).

## The Architectural Reality

- `Design authority:` `"/* A hover lights the card and never moves it: a lift clipped the top border and moved every target inside the card. */"` (`resources/css/src/apps/portal/Viewport.css:174`, shipped in `#21651` / PR `#21674`) and operator visual direction on `#/home` (`2026-11-23`).
- **Home card consumers (`Portal.view.home.ContentBox`):** Both `apps/portal/view/home/parts/Features.mjs:29` (6 cards) and `apps/portal/view/home/parts/AiToolchain.mjs:57-107` (6 cards) instantiate `Portal.view.home.ContentBox` (`apps/portal/view/home/ContentBox.mjs:18`), whose root VDOM node is `<a class="portal-content-box">` (`ContentBox.mjs:39-44`).
- **Root `<a ...>:focus-visible` vs descendant `:has(:focus-visible)`:** In `AudienceDoors.mjs` and `services/Container.mjs`, `.portal-glass-card` is a `<div>` wrapping inner links/buttons, so `Viewport.css:203-204` matches `&:hover, &:has(:focus-visible)`. Because `ContentBox` renders `<a ...>` as the card root itself, CSS `:has(:focus-visible)` does **not** match self-focus on `<a class="portal-glass-card">:focus-visible`; `.portal-glass-card` must include `&:focus-visible` alongside `&:hover` and `&:has(:focus-visible)`.
- **Grid cell sizing vs standalone `.portal-glass-card` defaults:** `.portal-glass-card` sets standalone column defaults (`margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto; max-width: 800px; padding: 2.5em;`, `Viewport.css:164-170`) used by `#/services` (`apps/portal/view/services/Container.mjs`). Inside CSS Grids (`AudienceDoors.css:55-65`, `Features.css:1-9`, `AiToolchain.css:37-45`), cards stretch to their grid track (`margin: 0; max-width: none; min-width: 0;`).
- **Only other `.portal-content-box` consumer in the repository:** `Portal.view.about.MemberContainer` (`apps/portal/view/about/MemberContainer.mjs:19`, `#/about-us`, 4 static profile cards with `cls: ['portal-about-member-container', 'portal-content-box']` and inner GitHub/LinkedIn toolbar buttons). Retiring `.portal-content-box`'s own card chrome/lift in `Viewport.css` while adding `'portal-glass-card'` to both `ContentBox` and `MemberContainer` removes the deprecated lift Portal-wide without breaking `#/about-us` (keeping `max-width: 800px; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;` and `cursor: default` on non-anchor `MemberContainer`).
- **CSS source & tokens:** Portal styles live directly in pure CSS under `resources/css/src/apps/portal/` and `resources/css/theme-neo-{dark,light}/apps/portal/Viewport.css` (where all `--portal-glass-card-*` tokens and `@keyframes portal-glass-card-{sweep,glint}` already exist). If running against `dist/` builds, `node ./buildScripts/build/themes.mjs -f -n -t all -e dev` refreshes packaged CSS.

## The Fix

1. **Adopt `.portal-glass-card` on `ContentBox` (and `MemberContainer`):**
   - In `apps/portal/view/home/ContentBox.mjs`, update `baseCls` to `['portal-content-box', 'portal-glass-card']` (with concise `@summary` JSDoc).
   - In `apps/portal/view/about/MemberContainer.mjs`, include `'portal-glass-card'` in `cls` so `#/about-us` retains glass card chrome once `.portal-content-box` drops its legacy surface rules.
2. **Retire the deprecated lift-up rules and support root `&:focus-visible` in `resources/css/src/apps/portal/Viewport.css`:**
   - Remove `background-color`, `border`, `border-radius`, `box-shadow`, `transform: translateY(-4px)` (`&:hover`), and `transform: scale(0.99)` (`&:active`) from `.portal-content-box` (`Viewport.css:93-117`), keeping `.portal-content-box` scoped to grid-card layout, link reset (`text-decoration: none; text-align: left; color: var(--sem-color-text-neutral-default); display: flex; flex-direction: column; margin: 0; max-width: none; min-height: 300px; min-width: 0; padding: 2rem;`), `a.portal-content-box { cursor: pointer; }`, `h4.portal-content-box-headline` (`color: var(--sem-color-text-primary-default); font-family: "GT-Planar", sans-serif; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 600; opacity: 1`), and `.portal-content-box-content li::marker`.
   - In `.portal-about-member-container` (`resources/css/src/apps/portal/about/MemberContainer.css`), keep centered column sizing (`max-width: 800px; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;`) so `#/about-us` cards do not stretch full-bleed after `.portal-content-box` sets `max-width: none; margin: 0;` for grid tracks.
   - In `.portal-glass-card` (`Viewport.css:203-204`), widen `&:hover, &:has(:focus-visible)` to `&:hover, &:focus-visible, &:has(:focus-visible)` (with clean focus outline handling on `a.portal-glass-card:focus-visible`) so Tab-focusing a `ContentBox` `<a>` card triggers the border sweep and glass glint identically to pointer hover.
3. **Verify unclipped borders & motion across viewports and themes:**
   - Confirm `Features.css` (`1440×900`, `<= 1000px` 2-col, `<= 700px` horizontal scroll strip) and `AiToolchain.css` (`1440×900`, `<= 900px` 1-col) never clip the `inset: -1px` conic border sweep on top-row or edge cards in both `neo-theme-neo-dark` and `neo-theme-neo-light`.
   - Extend `test/playwright/unit/apps/portal/view/home/ContentBox.spec.mjs` and `test/playwright/e2e/portal/HomeAudienceDoorsNL.spec.mjs` to assert that `Features` and `AiToolchain` cards carry `portal-glass-card`, stay stationary (`rest.position === hovered.position`, zero `translateY`), keep their top border unclipped (`elementFromPoint` hit-test), run `portal-glass-card-glint` + `portal-glass-card-sweep` on both `:hover` and keyboard `:focus-visible`, and collapse animation durations to `0` under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`.

## Decision Record impact

`none` — Portal visual unification onto the existing `.portal-glass-card` primitive established in `#20971` and `#21651`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] All 6 cards in `Portal.view.home.parts.Features` and all 6 cards in `Portal.view.home.parts.AiToolchain` render with `.portal-glass-card` in `neo-theme-neo-dark` and `neo-theme-neo-light` and light in place on pointer `:hover` and keyboard `:focus-visible` (`portal-glass-card-glint` + `portal-glass-card-sweep`), with zero positional shift (`top` / `left` unchanged) and no `scale(0.99)` active shrink.
- [ ] No `transform: translateY(-4px)` or `transform: scale(0.99)` rule remains on `.portal-content-box` in `resources/css/src/apps/portal/Viewport.css`, and `#/about-us` (`Portal.view.about.MemberContainer`) and `#/services` (`ConnectNL.spec.mjs`) render without layout or hover regression.
- [ ] Top and outer card borders in `Features` and `AiToolchain` remain unclipped while hovered/focused at `1440 × 900` and `390 × 844`, and `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` preserves the static lit border/light while skipping both keyframe animations (`duration === 0`).
- [ ] Unit (`npx playwright test test/playwright/unit/apps/portal/view/home/ContentBox.spec.mjs -c test/playwright/playwright.config.unit.mjs`) and E2E (`npx playwright test test/playwright/e2e/portal/HomeAudienceDoorsNL.spec.mjs test/playwright/e2e/portal/ConnectNL.spec.mjs -c test/playwright/playwright.config.e2e.mjs`) pass, and the PR embeds `1440 × 900` before/after frames of `Features` and `AiToolchain` (rest + hovered, dark & light).

## Out of Scope

- Changing copy, routes, or grid column counts inside `AudienceDoors`, `Features`, `AiToolchain`, `Services`, or `About`.
- Portal Examples catalog cards (`Portal.view.examples.List`, governed separately by `D#21670`).

## Avoided Traps

- **Duplicating `@keyframes` or `--portal-glass-card-*` rules inside `ContentBox.css` / `Features.css` / `AiToolchain.css`:** `.portal-glass-card` and its dark/light tokens already live in `Viewport.css` (`Portal.view.Viewport`), which is loaded once for the entire Portal app.
- **Relying on `&:has(:focus-visible)` alone for `ContentBox`:** `ContentBox` renders `<a class="portal-content-box ...">` as its own root node; `:has(:focus-visible)` matches descendants only, so keyboard Tab onto a `ContentBox` card would miss the sweep and glint without `&:focus-visible`.
- **Leaving standalone `.portal-glass-card` `max-width: 800px; margin-left/right: auto` active on grid items (or breaking `#/about-us` when overriding it):** Grid cards in `Features` and `AiToolchain` need `max-width: none; margin: 0; min-width: 0;`, whereas stacked `MemberContainer` cards on `#/about-us` rely on centered `max-width` sizing.

## Related

- Related: #20682, #21651, #20971
